Reliant supports models from multiple providers. Use the model ID in workflow configurations and presets.

> **Note:** Reliant has been most extensively tested with **Anthropic** and **OpenAI** models. You may encounter issues when using other providers.

## Model Tags

Models are tagged to help with selection. You can also [bring your own model](/docs/settings/model-config#custom-models) with your own provider.

| Tag | Description |
|-----|-------------|
| `powerful` | Most capable models for the hardest work |
| `flagship` | Most capable models, best quality |
| `moderate` | Balance of capability and cost |
| `fast` | Optimized for speed |
| `cheap` | Low cost per token |
| `reasoning` | Extended thinking capabilities |

## Capabilities Legend

| Symbol | Meaning |
|--------|---------|
| {{< icon "wrench-screwdriver" >}} | Supports tool use |
| {{< icon "paper-clip" >}} | Supports attachments (images, PDFs) |
| {{< icon "save" >}} | Supports prompt caching |
| {{< icon "lightning-bolt" >}} | Supports streaming |
| {{< icon "light-bulb" >}} | Extended reasoning/thinking |

## Using Models

### Tag-Based Selection (Recommended)

Select models by capability tags for provider-agnostic workflows:

```yaml
# In presets or workflow nodes
model:
  tags: [flagship]      # Best quality model available
  
model:
  tags: [fast, cheap]   # Prefer fast+cheap, falls back to fast-only or cheap-only

model:
  tags: [local, fast]   # Prefer local, use fast cloud model as fallback
```

### Explicit Model ID

Select a specific model by ID:

```yaml
model:
  id: claude-4.5-sonnet
```

### In Workflow Inputs

Workflow inputs use model ID strings (for UI dropdown):

```yaml
inputs:
  model:
    type: model
    default: claude-4.5-sonnet  # Model ID string for input default
```

### In Presets

Presets can use tag-based selection:

```yaml
name: my-preset
tag: agent
params:
  model:
    tags: [flagship]  # Works with any provider
```

---

## Provider Configuration

Models require the appropriate provider to be configured in Settings → AI:

| Provider | Models |
|----------|--------|
| Anthropic | `claude-*` |
| OpenAI | `gpt-*` |
| Google | `gemini-*` |

See [API Keys & Providers]({{< relref "../settings/api-keys" >}}) for setup instructions.
